page: Google Cloud Platform n2d-standard-48 is a general-purpose server powered by an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor using the x86_64 architecture. It features 48 vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core, utilizing a dedicated CPU allocation. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage or GPUs are bundled with this configuration, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core and single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng and PassMark CPU tests. Cryptographic operations are also strong, supported by hardware-accelerated AES, VAES, and SHA-NI instruction sets. While ray tracing and image processing benchmarks score in the top 25%, general memory bandwidth, static web serving throughput, and database operations fall within the average middle 50% range.

For language model workloads, the server achieves strong text generation speeds of 288.49 tokens per second on small 135M models, though prompt processing and larger model inference perform in the average tier. Given the balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and strong multi-core compute capabilities, this server is configured for general-purpose workloads, software compilation, and multi-threaded decompression tasks.
